title: Inside Brazil’s Race to Secure Gas Supply
summary: TAG is the gas transmission operator responsible for the main transport corridor connecting Cabiunas, Brazil (Point I), the biggest gas injection point in the country, located from Rio de Janeiro to Ceara (Point O). TAG will play a central role in integrating new domestic gas supply from the Sergipe Alagoas deepwater project (SEAP), liquefied natural gas (LNG) entry points, and demand centers across Brazil’s Southeast and Northeast regions. The ECOMP Itajuipe compressor station proposal addresses a bottleneck in TAG’s pipeline network…
